scope: Offline-first healthcare screening prototype; English symptom-classification scope only

urgency_regression.input: I might be having trouble breathing.
Mujhe chest pain ho raha hai.

bilingual_evaluation.note: These are behavioral regression checks, not diagnostic accuracy tests. Different labels do not prove correct understanding; identical labels are warning signals requiring review.

limitations: Keyword-based urgency detection can miss warning signs.

The screening wrapper may produce misleading candidate labels.
